notes: Bounds and streams large catalogs, cancels stale requests, and retries transient network failures to reduce crashes on older Fire TV hardware.
Makes automatic Media3 and VLC fallbacks resilient to buffering, decoder startup, app backgrounding, and rapid errors while preserving playback position.
Fixes Continue Watching progress across exits and player fallbacks so short or zero position samples cannot erase a valid resume point.
Hardens saved-login refresh, account-expiration handling, secure credential migration, and background notifications.
Improves phone and TV scaling, Fire TV keyboard and D-pad focus, selectable player controls, audio and subtitle tracks, and quality controls.
Verifies update size, checksum, package, version, signing identity, and final download location before installation.
